eval: (async()=>{const c=document.getElementById('game');const r=c.getBoundingClientRect();const s=Game.scale,oy=Game.oy;const P=(dx,dy)=>({clientX:r.left+dx*s,clientY:r.top+oy+dy*s});const sleep=ms=>new Promise(z=>setTimeout(z,ms));const settle=async()=>{for(let i=0;i<150;i++){if(Game.grid.animInPlay===0&&Tween.list.length===0){await sleep(150);if(Game.grid.animInPlay===0&&Tween.list.length===0)return;}await sleep(80);}};const shoot=async(col)=>{const x=CONF.GRID.x+(col+0.5)*CONF.CELL_W,y=CONF.BORN.y;c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{pointerId:1,bubbles:true,...P(x,y)}));c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{pointerId:1,bubbles:true,...P(x,y-160)}));await sleep(50);c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{pointerId:1,bubbles:true,...P(x,y-160)}));await settle();};Game.model.data.inGuide=false;Game.grid.guideVisible=false;Game.grid.guideStep=-1;const cols=[2,2,1,1,3,3,2,0,4,1,2,3,0,4,2];for(const col of cols){await shoot(col);}await settle();const model=[];for(let x=0;x<5;x++)for(let y=0;y<8;y++){const b=Game.model.getBlock(x,y);if(b)model.push(x+','+y+'='+b.value);}const views=[...Game.grid.blocks.values()].map(v=>Math.round(v.vx)+','+Math.round(v.vy)+'='+v.value);const modelSet=[...model].sort().join(' ');const viewSet=[...views].sort().join(' ');return JSON.stringify({score:Game.model.data.score,curMax:Game.model.data.curMax,next:Game.model.data.next,modelCount:model.length,viewCount:views.length,match:modelSet===viewSet,model:modelSet,views:viewSet});})()
